page.overview:
Who is Bouldering Guy?

The Bouldering Guy is a boulderer who twisted his ankle and is trapped on Death Mountain. He has a love for climbing mountains, and is a regular customer of the Milk Bar in Kakariko Village. After injuring his ankle, he throws a Letter in a Bottle from his spot on Death Mountain to Lake Hylia explaining his predicament and asking for Premium Milk.

To obtain the Premium Milk, Link must go to the Milk Bar and speak to the Milk Bar Owner, who happily provides the Milk in return for the Letter in a Bottle. leaving none for Link. He then asks the young hero to dispose of his trash, an Empty Bottle. The Bouldering Guy can be found in the Kakariko Village Milk Bar afterwards, where he thanks Link once more.
